name: Geotab
description: Geotab is a fleet telematics platform built around GO vehicle hardware and the MyGeotab software environment. Current GO Core and GO packages cover GPS visibility, routing, maintenance, inspections, fuel insights, safety, compliance, predictive diagnostics, EV analytics, sustainability, and a large partner marketplace.
best_for: Fleets that want modular telematics packages, connected GO hardware, compliance and maintenance analytics, EV support, and a broad marketplace of partner solutions.
features: GO Core real-time GPS tracking, live map, trip history, event alerts, and basic routing/dispatch
Maintenance scheduling by odometer and engine hours plus inspections and work-order management
Fuel-economy visibility and fleet dashboards in MyGeotab
GO plan advanced collision-risk management, AI safety scoring, compliance, predictive maintenance, and diagnostics
EV monitoring, suitability analysis, emissions and sustainability reporting
Advanced routing and profitability optimization plus video-telematics integrations

tiers.name: GO Core
tiers.notes: Entry fleet-intelligence plan; Get Pricing. Includes hardware in the subscription price with no upfront device cost or installation fee on the current software-packages page.

tiers.name: GO
tiers.notes: Full platform adding advanced safety, compliance, predictive maintenance, EV/sustainability, and routing tools; Get Pricing.

pros: Clear functional split between GO Core and the fuller GO plan
Hardware is included in the subscription price on the current package page
Large Marketplace ecosystem and availability across 130+ countries
cons: Large-fleet pricing and custom configurations require sales contact
Advanced compliance, safety, predictive maintenance, and sustainability require the higher GO plan
